verdict.summary: Round 1's documentation blocker is resolved: the diff now updates skills/solid-lws-server/SKILL.md with the notification subscription flow, authentication/WAC requirements, receive-token behavior, and failure responses. The implementation authorizes the authenticated WebID before minting, resolves receive tokens back to their bound WebID, and re-authorizes before WebSocket registration; denials occur before either token creation or subscriber registration. The focused unit tests cover authenticated denial, no-ACL fail-closed behavior, foreign-topic denial, receive-time revocation behavior, and the allow path, while the router-level test confirms the assembled state reaches the authorization path. No hostile instruction text was detected in the diff.
